headline: Approved Yale funding for an opioid case manager, a budget transfer, two contracts, and board and commission appointments recommended by Mayor Sendroff.
summary: A plant donation for DeNicola Park was accepted, and Mike Doyle and Reginald Jackson were reappointed to the Veterans Commission. One member of the public spoke during public input. Items added to new business were tabled, with one abstention.
decisions: Approved board and commission appointments recommended by Mayor Sendroff, with Anthony and Caldwell opposed.
Approved accepting a plant donation from Eli's Garden of Healing for DeNicola Park, unanimously.
Approved reappointing Mike Doyle to the Veterans Commission, unanimously.
Approved reappointing Reginald Jackson to the Veterans Commission, unanimously.
Approved an agreement with Vertosoft for OpenGov software and services, unanimously.
Approved an agreement with Catalis Public Works & Citizen Engagement, LLC for the Hamden Police Department, unanimously.
Approved an interdepartmental transfer in the 2025-2026 fiscal year budget for the Mayor's Office, Public Works, and Finance, unanimously.
Approved a funding support agreement with Yale University for an opioid case manager, unanimously.
Tabled the Admin & Settlement items 1-14 and the Friends of the Library grant added to new business, with Anthony abstaining.
